name: Grave Domain
description: A legacy cleric subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

features: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave

grants.name: Circle of Mortality
grants.description: When a spell restores Hit Points to a creature at 0 Hit Points, use the maximum result for every healing die. Learn Spare the Dying without counting against cantrips; for you it has 30-foot range and casts as a Bonus Action.

grants.name: Eyes of the Grave
grants.description: As an action, until your next turn ends, sense the location of Undead within 60 feet unless behind Total Cover or protected from Divination; this reveals neither identity nor abilities. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1, restored on a Long Rest.

grants.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
grants.description: As an action, expend Channel Divinity to curse one visible creature within 30 feet until your next turn ends. The next attack that hits it treats it as vulnerable to all damage from that attack, then the curse ends.

grants.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
grants.description: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet suffers a critical hit, use your reaction to turn it into a normal hit and cancel critical-hit triggers. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1, restored on a Long Rest.

grants.name: Potent Spellcasting
grants.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of every Cleric cantrip you cast.

grants.name: Keeper of Souls
grants.description: Once per round when an enemy you can see dies within 60 feet and you are not Incapacitated, you or one chosen creature within 60 feet regains Hit Points equal to that enemy's Hit Dice.
